title: StudioEpisode
description: Studio Episode read resource. The API and desktop use the exact episode state values from studio.contract/v0.1. Capability summary is explicit so the UI fails closed instead of faking execution.

brief.description: Creative brief text. May contain long Vietnamese text.

version.description: Aggregate version; mutations must send Expected-Version.

revision_id.description: Current ProductionRevision id, or null when no revision exists.

ready.description: True only when a real provider/model route is configured and available.

reasons.description: Explicit reasons when not ready; never a fake fallback.
